Probably they mean also update the second user to "John" and "example@.com".

We need to ensure we don't mention the function name or anything else. Just the calls. The function calls should be in JSON format. The user didn't specify any special formatting. We'll just produce the calls.

We should produce two calls. The first call: user_id: 12345, update_info: {name: "John", email: "example@.com"}, database: "CustomerInfo". The second call: user_id: 67890, update_info: {name: "John", email: "example@.com"}, database: "CustomerInfo".

We should not add any other text. Just the calls. The user asked to "repeat the same process for another customer with user ID 67890, changing their name and email to the same value as well as well?" That might be a typo. But we interpret as same values. So we do that.

and
